body:
My note from at dusk: the field trial crew carried rinsed gloves. my brother started coughing. I had not yet heard that the siren began.

The first account was spoken quickly, as if there might be a bus to catch. I wrote it down before another person could replace it.

The person who was supposed to collect it had no time to stop. I did not put it back with the rest of the ordinary papers.
title: At dusk: rinsed gloves
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.
